title: Unreal 2 Lemon and Raspberry 100ml Shortfill E-Liquid
description: Unreal 2’s Lemon and Raspberry e-liquid is twice as tangy as your usual e-juice thanks to sharp, zesty lemons and pucker-sweet raspberries. The irresistible sour notes fall away on the exhale to something altogether smooth and refreshing and utterly moreish. This product contains 100ml of e-liquid in a 120ml shortfill bottle, with space for 2 x 10ml nicotine shots to let you tailor your juice’s nicotine content. For example, adding 2 x 10ml, 18mg nic shots will create 120ml of 3mg e-liquid. The e-liquid’s 70VG/30PG ratio makes it ideal for high-powered pod kits , mods and sub-ohm tanks .
